question: A landfill fills in 40 years at current waste growth of 7% a year. At 10% growth, roughly how much sooner?
answer: At 7% the volume doubles roughly every ten years; at 10% roughly every seven. Over four decades that gap compounds into more than a decade of life gone. Small differences in a growth rate are not small differences in an outcome.
move: Three percentage points on a growth rate cost this landfill twelve years.
trap: Treating a few extra percent as a small change.
simply: A pile that doubles every ten years is nothing for ages and then swallows the room. Make it double every seven instead and you do not add a little — you lose a decade.
